INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1600x900 or larger, opaque PNG. Follow the approved visual direction already inspected: near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush strokes, ivory-white heavy Japanese typography, hand-drawn ink hatching and expressive brush textures, few strong elements. NOT a photo, not photorealistic, not a 3D render.

Editorial source is fixed: on 2026-11-25 there are no games in B.PREMIER, B.ONE or B.NEXT, according to the manuscript's data acquisition at 07:30 JST. Do not add any claims of appearances, achievements, scores, statistics, injuries, or particular real games. The illustration is conceptual.

One real athlete, Bruce Kanno (菅野ブルース), selected randomly from the official current Chiba Jets roster. Identity/appearance was inspected from his official team profile photograph: a tall lean-athletic young adult with warm medium-brown skin, dark black hair in approximately five neat straight-back cornrow braids with a close faded haircut at the temples, long oval/angular face tapering to a firm chin, thick straight dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes, medium broad straight nose, full defined lips, no beard or mustache. Preserve these defining features in a highly recognizable ink drawing. Show his full face in a three-quarter front view, large enough to inspect. The cornrows must be visible. Do not draw the curly-haired subject of the style reference.

Composition: left 55 percent has spacious large text; right 45 percent has Bruce Kanno in a dynamic low forward-driving basketball dribble, knees flexed and torso leaning diagonally, one hand contacting the top of an orange basketball, other arm naturally bent for balance. His face is clearly visible in the upper right quadrant, with no hand or ball covering it. Render the athlete in ivory, black and subtle warm-tan ink shading; orange basketball is a small secondary prop. Plain ivory sleeveless sports jersey and black shorts without name, numbers, badges, logos or sponsor text. Expressive lime dry-brush diagonal behind him. Keep head, all hands and ball safely in frame with margins; intentional crop at lower thighs is fine. Exactly one person, two arms, anatomically natural hands. No arena specifics, no opposing player, no scoreboard, no actual game depiction. This is an illustration of a real athlete, not a fictional athlete.

Typography: precisely legible, professionally typeset heavy Japanese gothic headline, no pseudo-characters. Huge main Japanese headline on the left, strong hierarchy and generous safe margins. Plain text only; all names below are lettering, never graphical league logos.

Exact visible text, and no other text:

Large date above main headline: "2026.11.25"
Main headline, extremely large, ivory or lime: "試合なし"
Supporting line below headline: "B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT"

Footer left, easily readable on a clean dark strip: "イラスト（AI生成）"

Never put the athlete name or jersey number in the image. Do not copy any names, numbers, scores, dates or sentence from the approved style reference except the generic site title and AI label above. No team/league logos, no sponsor marks, no pasted official photograph. The illustration must be an original hand-drawn ink treatment. Make the overall layout bold, clean and editorial, with crisp exact Japanese text and naturally drawn hands.
